name: Pehlwan Sandeep Malik
comment: Subah kushti practice ke baad Pehlwan Badam Ragda se tagdi recovery drink poore Israna me nahi hai. Asli kesar aur silbatte ka badam!

name: Dr. Mohit Narwal
comment: 100% pure taaza nichoda hua juice, no added water, no sugar. Clinic aate waqt rozana yahi se mosambi juice leta hu.

comment: Nayi Cold Coffee ₹100 me full thick creamy aur crispy paneer grill sandwich protein fuel ke liye ek number hai!

comment: Tender coconut malai shake aur strawberry shake dono hi lajawaab hain. Safaai aur shuddhata bilkul top class hai.
